adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, usernames are split and each is conditionally added only if `User.find_by_username(username)` returns a user; otherwise it is skipped. The action still returns `success_json` as long as `group.save` succeeds, even if no users were found/added. This can make a typo look like a successful add with no explicit error/partial-success feedback. However, the diff also shows prior behavior intentionally “succeeds silently when adding non-existent users” (that spec was removed along with the old PATCH-based membership update), so this is more a product/API feedback concern than a clear defect.
